$comment: Phase 0.1 Fast-tier coder task set. Deterministic tool-call probes; each task has an expected tool-invocation sequence. Pass = observed sequence matches expected, order preserved, no forbidden tools called. See ADR-0007 for methodology.

tasks.prompt: Read the file /workspace/probe/greeting.txt and tell me its exact contents. Do not modify the file.
tasks.notes: Simplest possible read probe. Validates tool selection and file-content propagation.

tasks.prompt: In /workspace/probe/config.py replace the line 'DEBUG = False' with 'DEBUG = True'. Do not run the file. Do not use bash.
tasks.notes: Validates str_replace_editor selection over the naive write_file / bash sed fallback.

tasks.prompt: Run 'echo probe03' in the workspace and report the exact stdout you observed. Do not create any files.
tasks.notes: Validates shell tool selection and stdout capture.

tasks.prompt: Create a new file at /workspace/probe/out/note.txt containing exactly the text 'from probe 04' followed by a newline. The directory /workspace/probe/out already exists.
tasks.notes: Validates write_file selection for brand-new file creation over bash echo redirection.

tasks.prompt: Read /workspace/probe/manifest.json, then create /workspace/probe/out/summary.txt containing only the value of its 'title' field followed by a newline.
tasks.notes: Validates a short read-then-write chain. Extra read_file calls are tolerated (agents may re-read for confirmation); write must appear exactly once after the first read.
